notlar: Layer and block numbers are 1-based (the sheet's numbering); the files store 0-based keys.
The ResNet-18 layer cosines of Table 16 are not drawn (a different layer axis); they stay in the reference sheet and the appendix text.
TOST p values are not drawn.
kararlar: Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the key carries 'bars: 90% interval (top), +-SD (middle, bottom)' and the bars are drawn through annotate.errorbar (sd) or with the kind recorded (ci90), so the manifest's errorbar_kinds is [ci90, sd] and fig_qc D3 checks the caption; the key strip grows by 3 mm (height 121 mm, ceiling 122).

Karar: the entropy-change interval is the run-level 90% interval of the TOST file, because the equivalence decision reads that interval against the +-0.05 nat margin; the council figure drew 95% t intervals, so the caption must say 90%.
Karar: the run values are drawn beside every mean, so no card is a single-series panel.
Karar: the block-output cosine card (Y8) draws the ViT's three token aggregations only; the CLS series keeps the ViT hue, the two others are ink and grey with their own shapes.

git.not: dirty_or_untracked lists every path above that is modified or untracked; until the scripts are committed, kod_ve_foy_sha256 is what pins the code and the sheet
